title: Globe Word Puzzle
description: Spin the globe and solve 12 word puzzles.

title: Rovatics Racers
description: Race two computer cars through 5 levels. Dodge cones, grab ⚡ boosts, and win the Champion Cup.

title: Rovatics Sudoku
description: 10 ever-harder levels, clues, celebrations, friend challenges and a leaderboard.

title: Card Clash
description: Top-trumps for 2–4 players: Cricket, Wrestling or Robot cards. Create a room, challenge friends or play bots.

title: Beam Bots
description: Bounce, split and tint laser beams to wake sleeping robots. 12 levels, colour mixing and a new Daily Lab puzzle every day.

title: Chain Reactor
description: Tap, charge and chain-explode! 100 levels in 10 worlds, endless Overload mode, themes and awards.

title: Devil Hunters
description: Lead a crowd of real running people over curving, hilly roads. Grab guns and bombs, smash obstacles and hunt down beasts, devils and the Devil King. Long levels in eight real-world settings.

title: PARALLAX · Rovatics Game Zone
description: A cinematic 3D puzzle adventure across five worlds and 100 levels: route channels, tilt gravity, steer light, balance pressure and team up with your own echo. Free hints, undo and checkpoints. No ads.
